The '''Imperial Office of Occupation and Law''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] organization instituted on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that were under military control. Among the Office's duties were to issue permits for individuals to be in public after curfew. The planet [[Derilyn]] had an Imperial Office of Occupation and Law during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
